items.prompt: Edit the referenced Mabinogi weapon inventory image into one crisp minimalist black-and-white line drawing icon for a website. Preserve its recognizable weapon silhouette, simplify ornate details to just a few bold clean black outlines with opaque WHITE enclosed fills. NO color, gray shading, texture, lighting, shadow, text, label, border, or backdrop. Actual transparent alpha background everywhere outside the weapon, including holes; never draw a checkerboard. Center the entire weapon on a square canvas, 10% clear margin, fill most of canvas, readable at 32px. Orient the main weapon axis EXACTLY diagonally from TOP LEFT to BOTTOM RIGHT (45 degrees downward to the right); weapon head/tip at upper left, handle/pommel at lower right. Do NOT orient it from bottom left to top right. Deliver one transparent PNG icon. Subject: Celtic Druid Staff, slim long shaft, distinctive pointed diamond ornamental staff head; retain these identifying features.
